body.description: a scavenger who camps in the dead mall, a wiry man in his forties: a welder's goggles pushed up on a shaved head, a patched orange safety vest over a bare chest, cargo shorts with bulging pockets, wrapped forearms, a crowbar through his belt, suspicious face. a person of a small South Texas border town generations after the sky turned white, sun-faded patched clothes, dust on the boots
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
